annotations.title: Find local businesses by category and city, with their contacts

description: Lead lists without a list of websites: every business of the given kinds in a city or area (open map data: name, category, address, phone, listed email, website, coordinates), each website then checked for emails, phones and social profiles. Says whether the email was found on the business site and whether the site still works. Use only for lawful business outreach (GDPR / CAN-SPAM). Runs the Apify Actor tacps126/contact-details on your Apify account (about $0.00125 per business, plus $0.00175 when contacts are found on its website; spend per call is capped at $0.5).

categories.description: Kinds of business in everyday words, e.g. ["dentist"], ["plumber","electrician"], ["indian restaurant"]. Empty = all businesses.

country_code.description: Two-letter country code of the city, e.g. "IN", "US", "GB".

exclude_chains.description: Leave out branches of chains and brands.

extra_input.description: Advanced: extra Actor input fields, merged over the defaults.

max_items.description: Maximum results to return (default 50, max 1000). Cost scales with this.

require_website.description: Only businesses that list their own website.

name: find_local_businesses

count.description: Number of records the Actor returned.

items.description: The records. Long text fields are shortened to 600 characters.

shown.description: Number of records included in `items` (can be lower than count when the result is long).

tool.description: Name of the tool that produced the result.

truncated.description: True when records were left out to keep the result short; ask for fewer items.

title: Find local businesses by category and city, with their contacts
